legend: Small irregular tissue fragment of tumour cells with enlarged, hyperchromatic nuclei and partially vacuolated cytoplasm. In the upper part of the image, two normal ciliated respiratory epithelial cells are present (bronchial brushing, Giemsa).
Irregular tissue fragments varying in size, consisting of tumour cells with enlarged, hyperchromatic nuclei and some cells with abundant cytoplasm (transbronchial FNAB, Giemsa).

High-power view of Fig. <<31590>>, showing tumour cells with enlarged, hyperchromatic nuclei; a coarse chromatin pattern with large nucleoli; and abundant foamy cytoplasm in some cells (transbronchial FNAB, Giemsa).

This case, which was subsequently shown to be KRAS mutant, shows a cohesive crowded tissue fragment with enlarged cells, hyperchromatic nuclei, large nucleoli, and abundant eccentric cytoplasm containing mucus (transbronchial FNAB, Giemsa).

Small cohesive tissue fragment of tumour cells with enlarged, hyperchromatic nuclei and abundant eccentric cytoplasm, filled with foamy mucus. Subsequent histopathology showed a lepidic adenocarcinoma (bronchial brushing, Giemsa).

Loosely cohesive tissue fragment of large tumour cells with enlarged and irregular nuclei, coarse chromatin, occasional large nucleoli, and eccentric cytoplasm. Note the intracytoplasmic neutrophil, a feature of adenocarcinoma with mucinous cytoplasm (transbronchial FNAB, H&E).

Crowded tissue fragment of poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma lacking glandular architecture, with enlarged and irregular nuclei, coarse chromatin, occasional large nucleoli, and variable (sometimes abundant) foamy cytoplasm (transbronchial FNAB, Giemsa).

Sheet of tumour cells with enlarged and irregular hyperchromatic nuclei showing marked anisonucleosis, and some goblet cells with large mucus-filled single vacuoles often indenting the nucleus (transbronchial FNAB, Pap).

Minute tissue fragment of very large tumour cells with large, often hyperchromatic nuclei and eccentric cytoplasm containing single clear mucin vacuoles. In the background, dense tissue fragments of normal ciliated epithelium are present for comparison of size (bronchial washing, Pap).

Two cohesive dense tissue fragments of tumour cells with enlarged, round, hyperchromatic nuclei, often with a centrally located macronucleolus. In the background are benign ciliated cells, alveolar macrophages, and benign squamous cells of the upper respiratory tract (bronchial washing, Pap).

Single very large tumour cell with eccentric abundant vacuolated cytoplasm and a large nucleus with pale chromatin and two large nucleoli. Note the benign ciliated cells in the background for comparison of the size (bronchial washing, Pap).

Strand of carcinoma cells with abundant eccentric intracytoplasmic eosinophilic mucin and irregular, indented, wrinkled nuclei with open chromatin. This tumour was negative for thyroid transcription factor 1 (TTF1), and KRAS was mutated (bronchoalveolar lavage [BAL], Pap).

3D rounded tissue fragment of adenocarcinoma cells with peripherally located nuclei showing perinucleolar clearing and prominent nucleoli, and with delicate cytoplasm (bronchoalveolar lavage [BAL], Pap).

Round to oval nuclei with mild variation in size and regular nuclear membranes, high N:C ratio, only mild chromatin abnormality, and small nucleoli. Histopathology showed a predominant lepidic architecture (transbronchial FNAB, Pap).
Poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma with irregularly shaped, crowded tissue fragments, with loss of polarity, prominent nucleoli, and necrotic debris in the background (transbronchial FNAB, Pap).
Well-oriented columnar cells with mainly basal, crowded nuclei, arranged along fibrovascular stroma suggestive of alveolar septa and lepidic architecture (Pap).
High-power view, showing columnar cells with crowded moderately enlarged and atypical nuclei arranged along a fibrovascular strand suggestive of an alveolar septum and lepidic architecture (Pap).
Tissue fragments of oriented large cells with large eccentric single eosinophilic mucin vacuoles and basal mildly enlarged and pleomorphic nuclei (Pap).
